title: Courier Operations Decision Table: Failed-Attempt Reason and the Late-Delivery Refund (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The fault share of a late-delivery refund on a Delivery & Pickup Services order depends on the reason recorded for a failed delivery attempt on that order, the most recent attempt on that order deciding where it has more than one. The late-delivery refund is the speed fee multiplied by the fault share, taken as a percentage; no rounding takes place at this step.

## Decision table

| Reason recorded on the most recent failed attempt on the late order | Fault share |
|---|---|
| no one available to sign | 50 percent |
| no ID presented | 50 percent |
| building access | 75 percent |
| address not found | 75 percent |
| weather or road closure | 90 percent |
| no failed attempt on the order | the plan's late-delivery refund percentage (100 percent on every plan) |

## Which attempt decides (hypothetical records)

| Failed attempts on the late order | Deciding reason | Fault share |
|---|---|---|
| attempt 1: weather or road closure | weather or road closure | 90 percent |
| attempt 1: building access; attempt 2: no one available to sign | no one available to sign (the most recent) | 50 percent |
| attempt 1: no ID presented; attempt 2: address not found | address not found (the most recent) | 75 percent |
| none | — | 100 percent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An express fee of $12.99 on a late order whose most recent failed attempt was recorded as no one available to sign: 12.99 multiplied by 50 percent is 6.495.
